tools.name: loop_usage_and_upgrade

tools.name: budget_record

tools.name: budget_weekly_report

tools.name: budget_budget_status

tools.description: [bot-secrets] Call any https API with your stored secrets filled in on our side: put {{secret:NAME}} in url, headers or body. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wake_check_wakes, fetch, cron, browser, rate, inbox, topic, ledger · Private data: memory_save_checkpoint, budget_open_budget, budget_record, approve_set_rules, library_publish, vault, secrets, fetch, cron, browser, lock, ai, ledger, sandbox, store · Public sink: library_publish, cron, browser, inbox, topic · Destructive: loop_check_step, loop_loop_status, memory_save_checkpoint, memory_resume, memory_list_checkpoints, memory_weekly_report, memory_usage_and_upgrade, budget_open_budget, budget_budget_status, library_install, vault, replay, secrets, cron, browser, inbox, ai, ledger, sandbox, store.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wake_check_wakes, fetch, cron, browser, rate, inbox, topic, ledger · Private data: memory_save_checkpoint, budget_open_budget, budget_record, approve_set_rules, library_publish, vault, secrets, fetch, cron, browser, lock, ai, ledger, sandbox, store · Public sink: library_publish, cron, browser, inbox, topic · Destructive: loop_check_step, loop_loop_status, memory_save_checkpoint, memory_resume, memory_list_checkpoints, memory_weekly_report, memory_usage_and_upgrade, budget_open_budget, budget_budget_status, library_install, vault, replay, secrets, cron, browser, inbox, ai, ledger, sandbox, store

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
